NEW POWER SUPPLY BOARD Early STARGATE games had a one-piece D-8359 Power Supply Board Assembly. In ROBOTRON and later STARGATE games, this assembly has been superseded by the new 0-8474 Power Board and outboard heat sink assembly C-8807. The new board features crowbar over-voltage protection on the +12VDC and +5VDC regulated outputs.

NEW TRANSFORMER On upright and cabaret-mode! games, a new power transformer with 8 primary and 12 secondary terminals (part no. 5610-09658) has also been substituted for the old transformer with 8 primary and 9 secondary terminals (part no. 5610-09535). The new transformer includes a 12.6V center-tapped secondary. Secondary termina! 20 and center-tap termina! 19 provide 6.3VAC general illumination power to pins 14 and 15 of plug 4P1. Cocktail table-model games continue to use a third power transformer with 6 primary and 9 secondary terminals (part no. 5610-09629).
UPRIGHT GAMES New transformer - new Power Supply: WI in, W2 & WS out.
Qld transformer - new Power Supply: W2 & W3 in, WI out and 2 Ohm 5W resistor added at R27. Pins 13, 14, & 15 of 4J1 are left disconnected when transformer secondary plug is connected.
New transformer - old Power Supply: Pins 13, 14, & 15 of 4P1 (transformer secondary connector) are unterminated at Power Supply 431 12-Pin connector.
COMPACT GAMES New transformer - new Power Supply: Wl in, W2 & W3 out.
Old transformer - new Power Supply: Wi, W2, &W3S in. Pins 13, 14, & 15 of 4J1 are left disconnected when transformer secondary plug is connected.
New transformer - old Power Supply: Pins 13, 14, & 15 of 4P1 (transformer secondary connector) are unterminated at Power Supply 4J1 12-Pin connector.
